about.title: About MyFinance
about.description: MyFinance helps you understand and manage your personal finances in one calm, private workspace. Track accounts, income, expenses, transfers, budgets, and goals with a clear view of your money.
about.featureAccounts: Organize accounts and see balances based on real financial activity.
about.featureTransactions: Record income, expenses, and transfers without counting transfers as income or expenses.
about.featureBudgetsGoals: Follow category budgets and personal savings goals.
about.featurePrivacy: Your financial records are protected by Supabase authentication and row-level security.
